workload_taxonomy.why_it_matters: Exercises call overhead, attribute lookup, and frame dispatch where JIT/frame-eval behavior is most visible.
Measures numeric steady-state loops where lowering and optimization quality can dominate.
Captures filesystem/network style latency where VM speedups may be bounded by system calls.
Stresses JSON/pickle/msgpack-style payload handling common in services and APIs.
Represents end-to-end request throughput and latency under realistic framework stacks.
Shows optimization ceilings when most cycles occur in native extensions (NumPy/Pandas/etc.).
